notes.title: Patch v1.0.2 goes LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers!

Patch v1.0.2 goes live today and with it, we're introducing a couple of useful features!

"Take care of" task
Now, instead of constantly checking what your cat and dog need, you can simply assign a "Take care of" task to the worker – they will automatically handle everything to make sure your pets are well.

https://i.imgur.com/MHkqquH.gif

Destroying multiple objects at once
Choose Destroying mode and then, while holding Shift, choose multiple ojects by dragging your mouse. That way you can quickly get rid of the trees in your way, for example.

https://i.imgur.com/cRTUHgE.gif

Shrinking fields
We have added a "Shrink" command that allows you to get rid of unneeded field tiles. It doesn't matter if they're empty or if there are crops growing there – if you want to shrink your field, just choose the command and choose the area to delete by dragging cursor while holding left mouse button. 

https://i.imgur.com/VpVGIM8.gif

Employee management window
Now you can conveniently manage all of your employees' tasks from one place! Access it by pressing the new button placed to the right of the screen. From here, you can see all of your employees, their statistics, you can abort tasks previously assigned to any of your workers and assign new tasks, It will definitely come in handy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/92bce1c2b643ab6bba029a5ba9a3fc83ff7b0010.png

There is more! Take a look at the changelog below to see all changes.

Fixes:
- fixed problems with creating profile with corrupted HKEYS
- fixed Chinese font in main menu
- fixed issues with the tutorial 
- fixed employee stuck in "Slaughterhouse"
- fixed building hedges
- fixed problems with standing employee after being fired

Features:
- added destroying multiple objects (hold "Shift" in removing mode)
- added looping task "Take care of"
- added "Employees management" window
- added shrinking gardens, crofts and fields
- added "Return to farm and unload products" interaction
- added possibility to upgrade "Wholesaler"
- added new texts in tutorial book
- added new weather effects (clouds and fog)
- interactions opens in click place, not in the middle of the object

Happy farming!
Farming Life Team

Hello, Farmers!

After weeks of hard work and reading your feedback we can present to you first patch for Farming Life! It includes some gameplay improvements and fixes that should get rid of many of those pesky bugs that have been bothering you for a while. Among them is the issue that caused corruption of save files. 
Hopefully, now you'll be able to play undisturbed and enjoy your Farming Life to the fullest!

You can find full changelog below!

Fixes:
- wholesaler's price visibility after buying it 
- possibility to run a wrong video in tutorial book 
- problems with "Sell and return" interaction 
- ghost on "Cow cheese factory" 
- cat and dog size 
- possibility to assign "Driving task" when an employee is tired 
- possibility to drive a car as a passenger

- harvester aborting task when the closest "Granary with driveway" is taken
- possibility to block animal during "Feeding task"

Features:
- added highlighting selected mode in the circle menu

- balance changes

- farmers in the daily ranking are a little bit stronger 
- lowered stats drop of animals(hunger, tidiness and health)

notes.title: Farming Life Pumpkin Challenge
notes.content:
Farmers!

We’re holding a special Farming Life Pumpkin Challenge as a way to celebrate Halloween!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/8a9fa01696192c190ca16268d9053f5cc3dba617.png

What is the Challenge about?

It’s quite simple! Include pumpkins in your farming space and show us a screenshot! Keep in mind that it’s not necessarily about filling your entire farm with pumpkins! Just build the most impressive farm, use pumpkins as a Halloween accent and capture its charm to the best of your abilities!

How long does it last?

Challenge lasts from October 28 to November 1. On November 2, we’ll choose and announce winners! In theory, you have time until November 1 11:59 PM CEST, but due to time zone differences, even if you’re a little late, as long as you make it before November 2 12:00 PM CEST, your entries will be accepted. :)
EDIT: Deadline extended to November 2 4:00 PM CEST!

Where to publish screenshots?

You can show us your screenshots on discussion thread dedicated to this Challenge or on our on Twitter. In the case of the latter, please make sure to tag our profile @PyramidLab and add #FarmingLifeGame tag! It’s very important to tag #FarmingLifeGame, as #FarmingLife covers a broad topic of farming overall and your entries may get lost there.

What about the prizes?

Our Challenge will have 3 winners and each one will receive a Steam key for newly released Gunslingers & Zombies! We’ll choose and announce winners on November 2! 

Good luck!
Farming Life Team

notes.title: Devlog #25: Random Quests
notes.content:
Greetings, Farmers! 😃

https://i.imgur.com/6MZfaG6.gif

We’d like to introduce you to the last few important mechanics in our game.

We believe we haven’t told you about Random Quests yet! 

https://i.imgur.com/oUtXTtz.gif

What are these? Other than Mayor's Competition missions, which can be picked at a specific time via Newspaper menu, Random Quests serve as an additional source of profit for you. Contrary to the former, though, they appear at random time and order. These missions are given out by various citizens, who spontaneously come to Sam asking for help. When they do, a notification appears, and a player has a choice to accept the request or refuse. It’s worth taking advantage of these quests, as they can provide you with a good amount of additional money, experience and improve your relationship with citizens.

To give you an additional insight into your status in the town’s little community, we have also included a Ranking system!

https://i.imgur.com/95EnpDQ.gif

This window will appear at the end of every day and show you how much progress you’ve made compared to other local farmers. As you can see, Sam has a long way to go to reach the top but it’s definitely possible! His success is up to you! 💪

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to chat with us about Farming Life, as well as any other games we’re working on. ❤️

Stay well!
Farming Life Team

notes.title: Devlog #24: Progression System
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers!

https://i.imgur.com/csBZKwP.gif

It’s time for another update! While our team continues working on Farming Life, testing and polishing various game mechanics, we’d like to tell you a thing or two about gameplay features we haven’t described yet.

Let’s start with the Level Progression System!

https://i.imgur.com/RuPziL8.gif

Much of what you’ll be able to buy and achieve in game depends on your experience. Your experience is measured via a familiar Level System. Every action you perform – tending to your fields, completing missions, cutting down trees, to name a few – provides you with experience, which accumulates and eventually allows you to level up. The higher your level, the more objects, cars, buildings and quests will become available to you. Don’t be afraid to try out new things, experiment, build, destroy and start anew – none of your efforts will be wasted! 😊

Of course, your beginnings will be humble and at first, you may not have enough space to really let your creativity run wild. However, with time and growing resources, you’ll be able to expand your farm’s area!

https://i.imgur.com/WI4ZOuS.gif

Much like objects mentioned above, buying new areas will require not only money, but also unlocking – and for that, you have to reach a high enough level. We’re making sure the Progression System is smooth enough, so you’ll be able to start expanding your farm as soon as you learn the ropes of farm management. 🙂

That’s it for today! If you’d like to chat with us, make sure to join our Discord server! Stay tuned, another devlog will drop soon!

See you soon!
Farming Life Team

notes.title: Devlog #23: Small animals and new vehicles!
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers! 👋

https://i.imgur.com/9iYi08C.gif

It’s been a while! Our apologies for that. Our team has been continuously polishing the game, while our testing team along with our publisher have both been great help by pointing out issues and room for improvement. As a result, the game has gone through many small changes, some of which would be difficult to show you.

Nevertheless, we’ve realized it’s about time to give you some update on our progress, and so, we’d like to tell you about a few things.

Firstly, farm animals can now give birth to small animals, meaning that your humble farm can expand quickly if you provide animals with good conditions and care. To have young animals appear on your farm, you need to have two animals of the same species and make sure they’re both clean, healthy and well-fed. If you fulfill these conditions, you’ll eventually be greeted with this sight.

https://i.imgur.com/gc2cfVc.gif

We have also added two new vehicles to the game! The red one you can see below is the “basic” vehicle Sam and Linda have in their possession. Eventually, though, once your farm grows, so will your income and then you’ll be able to get the lovely blue or elegant black pickup truck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/e24d2202bb9b87bc0b8227e872bc7dd595a543b4.png

Of course, the trailer mentioned in the previous devlog is still in the works – we’ll show you the end result as soon as our publisher has it ready. 🙂

As always, we invite you all to our  Discord server, where you can freely talk to us about our games!

Stay healthy!
Farming Life Team

notes.title: Devlog #21: Optimization and new buildings!
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers!

We’ve been quiet for some time now. Rest assured though, development of Farming Life is not slowing down! 

The game still requires some work before we can hand it over to you with confidence. While most of the big features have been implemented, we are now handling more subtle matters, such as polishing UI, tweaking balance, as well as optimization.

We have also been working on lighting and colors. Farming Life is supposed to be a relaxing, uplifting game and we believe aesthetics contribute a lot to that charm. :) Therefore, all the objects now have shadows shifting according to time, and everything is now brighter and much more pleasant to look at! 

You can see a comparison below:

BEFORE

notes.title: Farming Life Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers! 

We would like to thank you for playing Farming Life Demo during the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition! We've gathered tons of valuable feedback and suggestions, which helped us improve the demo version and introduce improvements to the upcoming full release!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/696daefc89fe03c3cb6be74e90940434e6d0eeef.png

Our demo is still available on Steam, so while waiting for the full release you can try it out again and check our progress! 

The full Demo changelog below: 

Things we have added:
- added ambient sounds(barking dogs, chickens, etc)
- added info that animals requires space in croft
- added info about blocked interactions(in tutorial)
- added notification sound
- added day/night sounds
- added text about field/croft price
- added "Everything is fine task"

Bugs that have been fixed:
- fixed sliding employees
- fixed boxes capacity
- fixed bug with employees coming back home after skipped night
- fixed random tutorial blocker
- fixed showing translation keys instead of texts
- fixed wrong music loop
- fixed road not detecting other roads
- fixed too dark weather
- fixed lamps not having light when built during night
- fixed blocked production in windmill
- fixed bakery sound looping
- fixed removing road when progressbar wasn't full
- fixed employee stuck during working on a field
- fixed moving animals out of croft
- fixed roads connections on low/very low
- fixed problems with expanding fields and crofts
- fixed problems with bakery
- fixed not hiding exclamation marks on fields
- fixed employees ignoring field tiles
- fixed wrong animations on different aspect ratios
- fixed ui scaling
- fixed idle animation of employees when merging crofts
- fixed unused tile on field
- fixed animals leaving crofts
- fixed errors with buildings and employees working in buildings
- fixed blocked removing crofts
- fixed removing fields not subtracting money
- fixed not disabling lights after leaving vehicle
- fixed missing gate after merging crofts

Other implemented features and your suggestions:
- locked camera movement when tutorial window is opened
- rows in trade market are no longer refreshing after each buy
- longer intro time
- overall ui fixes
- changed navmesh pathfinding
- employee continues work after being hold for longer than a 5 seconds
- rebalanced employees
- changed tutorial croft step(now player has to build road to croft)
- crofts entrance react to employee
- fully grown field can't die


Stay tuned for more details regarding the full release! Feel free to join our Discord Community, and visit our social media. 

Farming Life Team

notes.title: Devlog #13: Functional Buildings
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!

Today we would like to talk about various functional buildings using for animal housing, food processing, storing your products, and accommodation for your workers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/b2dc96fd6aeed90f0b1440f3caa4a3dc82067fec.png

Living on a farm doesn't only mean working on the fields or managing your farm. Daily tasks include making sure that your livestock has appropriate housing, processing food as well as storing your products properly in dedicated functional buildings. 

Various livestock housing facilities ensure the welfare and good health, which guarantees high-quality animal products.

https://i.imgur.com/zWJGLGk.png

Inside food processing facilities, such as smokehouse, windmill and bakery, you can prepare the meat for the consumption, produce flour, and bake bread and buns. 

https://i.imgur.com/jJuSTmP.png

After food processing, you have to store your products inside granaries and silos. Proper storage is crucial if you want to sell high-quality products. 

https://i.imgur.com/eJF2h7q.png

When your farm grows bigger, you'll need to hire additional farmers. To do this, you have to ensure them accommodation by building small and big lodgings. 

https://i.imgur.com/SVZH8CI.png


To stay up to date with devlogs from Farming Life, keep following us on Steam and Social Media! If you have any questions or just want to know more about the game, feel free to join our Discord server.

notes.title: Devlog #12: Modern vs. Traditional Farming
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!

What type of a farmer are you - a modern agricultural entrepreneur or a traditional farmer?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/f89a81c173b9dddc5cb8845e8a87097ee3544a19.png


Modern agriculture requires you to use advanced technology and specialized machines, such as harvesters and tractors. You have to buy expensive equipment, but maintaining your farm will be more efficient, and your production will be greater. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/343562b5c42c87725500daeaaf253a11effcb39e.png


Traditional farming is more labor-intensive for farmers and requires you and your team spent hours in the fields. The production will be smaller, but the quality of your products will be higher.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34488148/b84e74d9a3970ec3fd891b14e5e5c825625bc015.png
